static_not_runtime: this is a static source gap audit, not an on-device root cause of the T37 miss

observation_primitive.only_source: hidumper -s WindowManagerService -a '-a' (29 call sites across the reentry family)
observation_primitive.nature: 1-second integer-sleep poll of a focus/window SNAPSHOT, not an event stream
observation_primitive.parsed_fields: WindowName DisplayId Pid WinId Type Mode Flag ZOrd Orientation + 'Focus window: N' footer

state_machine.trigger: a spawn fires only on a verified desktop(SceneBoard)->host(imehost0) FOCUS transition (UNARMED->DESKTOP_SEEN->HOST_CONSUMED), lines 31-36, 43-98
state_machine.gap: because the input is a polled snapshot, a desktop focus between two 1s samples is missed, leaving UNARMED; a later host focus is then consumed silently with no spawn. Acknowledged at OUTER-ADAPTER-READY.json:66 ('extremely fast Home-to-icon transitions can be missed').

must_preserve: identity gate, window-ownership gate, single-instance (HOST_CONSUMED/one-spawn) gate, no-event->no-autostart (UNARMED quiet). No code change proposed.
activity_adapter_layer_is: ANDROID CHILD BRIDGE, not the imehost0 host. bms/src/adapter/framework/activity translates OH AMS ScheduleAbilityTransaction (isNewWant + wantJson) into the bridged ANDROID app child Activity.onResume/onCreate (AbilitySchedulerBridge.java:81-120 onScheduleAbilityTransaction; ability_scheduler_adapter.cpp:403-502). isNewWant/wantJson here belong to the launched Android child AFTER spawn, inside the child runtime — not a pre-spawn host tap signal and not consumed by the reentry guardian.

real_host_entry.source_overrides: onCreate / onWindowStageCreate(windowStageEvent) / onForeground / onBackground / onWindowStageDestroy / onDestroy; each only record()s a hilog WL_IME_HOST line and TRUNC-overwrites files/window-state.json with {event,time,details}
real_host_entry.source_fact: the located host EntryAbility reads no Want and implements no onNewWant; this is the accepted source fact

distinguish_human_tap_from_no_event: From the located host SOURCE: not possible. The source reads no Want and no LaunchParam; onForeground/windowStageEvent carry no cause. A source-level reliable "genuine user tap vs recovery/notification/autostart" discriminator does not exist today. onNewWant + LaunchParam.launchReason/launchReasonMessage is the CANDIDATE mechanism, but requires real on-device Want/launchParam evidence and is unimplemented here.
actionable: Deployed host entry source is proven = org.westlake.imehost EntryAbility.js 9dc302d9 (ABC bb1eccd3 in HAP df385638; T32-accepted). It has no per-tap Want/launchParam signal; onForeground fires on taps and non-taps alike. A reliable per-launch-cause signal would require implementing onNewWant + reading LaunchParam, with real captured Want evidence — a code + measurement task, out of scope. The generic 922a13a5 template is NOT the deployed source and must not be used as a substitute.
correction_history: Earlier passes wrote "host not located / host layer unaudited", then over-claimed onNewWant as a reliable per-tap human signal, then wrote "deployed host source equivalence unproven (DIGEST #91 :973)". onForeground_reason.source_fact: onForeground() takes no argument and records {}; carries no launch reason
onForeground_reason.platform_semantics: OH invokes it on every foreground transition (cold create, user re-tap, recovery, auto-startup); source cannot label which, so it is not a human-tap discriminator

onNewWant_candidate.what_it_is: onNewWant(want, launchParam) is a NEW-START-REQUEST callback to an already-created ability; not by itself proof of a physical user tap
onNewWant_candidate.status: not implemented in the deployed/baseline source 9dc302d9 (proven)
onNewWant_candidate.would_need: implementing it AND reading AbilityConstant.LaunchParam.launchReason (APP_RECOVERY/AUTO_STARTUP) + launchReasonMessage (API18+)/DESKTOP_SHORTCUT-style ReasonMessage (API20+), with real captured Want/launchParam on this API; a desktop SHORTCUT reason != every desktop-icon launch; want.parameters is not a ready reliable human marker without that evidence
